g.text: Hairbrush reset: numbered pins and ten lock routes
Top-view construction diagram. Colours label routes only; use one hair product/batch.
Each lock: A handleward → B tipward → C handleward → D tipward.
Rows 01–10 carry one lock each; row 11 is empty. Both ends remain loose.
Column pitch 16 mm; row pitch 6 mm. Ends extend about 11 mm beyond the head.
Tuck below ball tips, without knots or full wraps. Do not glue or tie locks.
Verify routes and end locations before the trial. See routes.json for coordinates.
Physical reset verification is still required. This diagram is not a real-trial photograph.
